tools.name: parse_date_query
tools.description: Parses queries like "90 business days from today in uganda" into a normalized operation, answers it, and returns the auditable receipt. Ambiguous dates (03/04/2027) return needsClarification instead of a guess.

tools.name: add_days
tools.description: The date N whole calendar days after a date (exclusive counting: the start date is day 0). Omit date for today in tz. For working days use business_days; for the gap between two dates use days_between.

tools.name: subtract_days
tools.description: The date N whole calendar days before a date (exclusive counting: the start date is day 0). Omit date for today in tz. For working days use business_days; for the gap between two dates use days_between.

tools.name: days_between
tools.description: Signed whole calendar days from the from date to the to date, midnight to midnight in tz: positive when to is later, negative when it is earlier. Endpoints are exclusive, so this is the gap and consecutive dates are 1 apart. Either date may be "today", resolved in tz. For working days between two da

tools.name: business_days
tools.description: Span mode (from+to): business days between two dates, exclusive of the start day, inclusive of the end day. Add mode (days, optional date): the date N business days away. Passing from or to selects span mode and needs both; days and date are then ignored, so add mode takes its start date in date, no

tools.name: invoice_due
tools.description: Due date for Net-N payment terms (calendar days, invoice date = day 0). Optional roll-forward past weekends and, with a jurisdiction or custom calendar, public holidays.

tools.name: next_occurrence
tools.description: The next occurrence strictly after the base date (default today) of either a tracked event slug (e.g. "christmas") or a weekday (0 = Sunday .. 6 = Saturday). Provide exactly one of event/weekday.

tools.name: holidays
tools.description: Observed public holidays with the nominal (legal) date and status: rule (statutory) or declared (officially declared for that year). Declared-only holidays are omitted for undeclared years, with a holiday_data_incomplete warning.

tools.name: explain
tools.description: Runs any operation and returns the receipt plus human-readable derivation steps. Set op, then pass the fields that operation's own tool takes. Use it when the user asks how an answer was reached.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "add_days" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "The date N whole calendar days after a date (exclusive counting: the start date is day 0)." → after: "The date N whole calendar days after a date (exclusive counting: the start date is day 0). Omit date for today in tz. For working days use business_days; for the gap between two dates use days_between."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
